title: Exposing the Copycat Problem of Imitation-based Planner: A Novel Closed-Loop Simulator, Causal Benchmark and Joint IL-RL Baseline
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical challenges in autonomous driving, specifically imitation learning's tendency to rely on spurious correlations (the 'copycat problem'). It proposes a simulator and a causality benchmark to evaluate driving policies. It does not contain any content related to religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or benchmarking morals and ethics.
